title: Page 8
content_zh:
石澄音跌坐在冰凉的地板上，她知道他是去找那个贱女人，那个年轻漂亮，还能生小孩的贱女人！

她不懂，为什么她会这么悲惨？这不是她应该过的生活，她是天之骄女，妈妈出身名门，爸爸优秀出色，她在家人的期待中出生，聪明又漂亮……如今她却已经不再是姊妹淘之间的领头，她说的话也不再让人信服。

而这全是因为她失去了庇佑。

“如果爸爸没出事、外公没放话，黄品杰，你哪敢这样对我？”

恨恨的望着丈夫离去的背影消失在眼前，石澄音缓缓站起来，脚步沉重的沿着长廊慢慢走，恍惚间走到了待产室附近……

“怎么会突然早产！”一个老人家用中气十足的语气怒吼，整条走廊都能听见他宏亮的声音。“昨天来家里看我时人还好好的，结果一回去就要生了？！你们给我说说，这是怎么一回事？”

石澄音被吼声吓了一跳，但立刻就认出了声音的主人。“外公？”

她站在转角处，看见病愈后恢复良好的外公正站在待产室前，对着一脸憔悴的文景瑞和温希恩痛骂。

原来温希琳早产了啊……真是活该。她恶毒的想。

而造成温希琳早产的两名元凶则互望一眼，心虚地低头。

“我跟希恩因为观念不合吵了一架，琳琳劝着劝着就……”文景瑞咳了咳，既抱歉又自责地道。

温希琳送到医院后产道一直不开，医生说了，若产道的状况不见好转，建议进行剖腹，但她坚持要再试看看，只因为自然生产对宝宝比较好。一想到她痛了十几个小时，文景瑞难掩焦躁地爬着凌乱的头发。

温希恩也被吓坏了，不顾已是深夜时分，明早还要上课就跟着来医院，一整晚都没有睡，站在待产室外听着姊姊的痛叫，她脸色发白，后悔不已。“我以后不敢了。”她因为担心姊姊的状况，遂请了假，留在医院等消息。

“有什么事情吵到要琳琳劝架？给我说清楚！”

在温祖雄养病期间，温希琳时常来探望，帮他削水果，还为他煮粥——虽然不好吃，想他一屋子的女人，老婆有三个，女儿生了七个，以及数不清的外孙女，却从没吃过她们亲手煮的东西或亲手削的水果，反而全都让他锦衣玉食的养着。

所以温希琳这样的贴心让他软化了，问她为什么会想亲近他这个老人，得知他不过是看见她被欺负顺手救了，她便从儿时感激崇拜至今，令他深深懊悔对她的错待，想着之后一定要好好疼爱她。

怎料今早是这两个不懂事的家伙吵架害得她早产，温祖雄火大了。

可罪魁祸首们却闭上嘴巴，死都不开口。

“快说！”温祖雄越看越觉得这两人有鬼，非要他们开口不可。

此时医生走了出来，带来一个好消息。

“产妇产道全开，现在已准备进产房了，文先生你要进来陪你太太吗？”

“我要去。”文景瑞立刻从椅子上站了起来，没有心情跟温祖雄打招呼，四肢僵硬地跟随医生进去。他早就跟温希琳保证过，她生宝宝的时候他会陪在她身边。

看着这外孙女婿紧张到走路都同手同脚的，温祖雄不禁感到好笑，又觉得欣慰。还好，希琳嫁了个疼她的男人。

“希恩，你跟你姊夫在吵什么？一个小孩子跟大人吵架象话吗？连你姊姊劝你都不听，说，发生什么事？”温祖雄回头质问温希恩。

只见温希恩脸皴了皱，先是一副不想说的模样，而后她露出沉思的神情，看了看温祖雄严肃的脸，这才开口。“外公——”

头顶艳阳高照，假装进医院借厕所的记者偷拍到了珍贵的新闻画面，立刻透过联机，让民众看见文景瑞在病房中抱着刚出生的儿子，一脸紧张到吓坏的表情，以及亲手喂食生产后的妻子的深情画面。

而文景瑞的左右手傅钰也到医院外头来，分发以最快速度冲洗出来的婴儿脚丫照片，并给记者带来进一步的讯息。“各位记者前辈们，我们总裁说了，想让夫人好好调养，待满月一定请各位来吃饭。”赶人的意思很明显。

记者们得到想要的画面，能交差了，也就不坚持要在原地等，纷纷收拾东西准备离开医院。

傅钰则继续分发照片给没拿到的媒体，突然一阵风吹来，他一个没拿稳，手中的照片掉了几张，他连忙弯腰四处捡着照片。

此时一双暗红蟒蛇纹尖头高跟鞋踩上其中一张照片，鞋子的主人缓缓蹲下身，拾起照片，是石澄音。

她停在一辆SNG车前，眼神阴毒的狠瞪着温希琳儿子的小脚丫，耳边传来SNG车内正在播报的新闻——

“为大家插播一则消息，波塞顿游艇集团总裁文景瑞在十个月前成为有妇之夫，也在一小时之前成为父亲，现在为民众播放本台独家画面，从照片上来看，无论是抱小孩、喂老婆吃饭，他做来都得心应手，宠妻爱子的模样可以说是新好男人的最佳写照……”

石澄音用着缓慢的动作回头，看见未掩上的车门内有数个画面，全是温希琳和文景瑞模糊的偷拍照片。

“哈哈……哈哈哈……”她诡异地笑了起来。看着那些恩爱的画面，再想到方才听见的讯息，她就觉得非常好笑。

“我就说嘛，温希琳怎么可能钓到大鱼？一切都是假的，假的。”石澄音想，如果全台湾人都知道文景瑞神秘的妻子是个父不详的私生女，而那些恩爱甜蜜的模样根本是谎言，温希琳会有什么样的表情呢？

这个女人毁了她的人生，从她送来那张喜帖开始，一切就全变调了！如果不是她，外公现在还会继续疼爱她，父亲还会是前景建设的总经理，她也还会是那个众人捧在手掌心的石澄音。

温希琳，既然你毁了我，那我也该礼尚往来，不是吗？

“你们想要独家吗？”石澄音对还未离开的记者开口。“文景瑞一直对自己的太太很保护，没人知道她是谁、从哪里来，不过我知道她的底细。”

“是吗？你说说看，也希望你能提出证据。”记者挑了挑眉，半信半疑的拿起录音笔，开始录音。

捡起最后一张照片，傅钰抬起头，就看见正在跟记者说话的石澄音，也听见她说了什么，他微微挑眉，斯文的脸庞忍不住浮现同情之色。

“这女人真的是无药可救的笨蛋，怎么到现在还搞不懂，惹夫人就等于是惹到总裁呢？”傅钰摇头叹息，转身回到医院，向上司报告这件事。

一周后。

下午四点，人声嘈杂的麦当劳里，一群女大学生端着自己的餐点，在靠近窗户的位置坐了下来，兴奋的八卦着。

“你们看新闻了吗？我原本不知道前景建设、文氏金控、波塞顿游艇集团是什么，多亏了这段时间的新闻，我已经搞清楚这几间公司在干么，举凡股价、人事，我都了如指掌，还有还有，连论文主题我都想好了，就做“波塞顿集团的堀起”！喔对，我爸还买了这三家的股票，有赚钱耶。”

其中一名女大生兴奋的说着，结果立刻被嘘。

“拜托，你是不是女人啊？麻烦罗曼蒂克一点好吗？”另一个短发的女大生白了眼姊妹淘，而后露出梦幻的神情。“天哪，我也好想要这样一个深情的男人，小时候照顾我，长大后仍不能忘情，重逢后闪电结婚，延续两小无猜的深厚情谊！”
content_en:
Shi Chengyin fell to the cold floor. She knew that he was looking for that bitch, that bitch who was young and beautiful and could have children!

She doesn't understand why she is so miserable?This is not the life she should live. She is a proud daughter of heaven. Her mother is from a famous family and her father is outstanding. She was born with the expectations of her family. She is smart and beautiful... But now she is no longer the leader among the sisters, and what she says is no longer convincing.

And this is all because she lost her blessing.

"If nothing happened to dad and grandpa didn't say anything, Huang Pinjie, how could you dare to do this to me?"

Watching her husband's departing figure disappear in front of her eyes with hatred, Shi Chengyin stood up slowly, walked slowly along the corridor with heavy steps, and walked to the delivery room in a daze...

"Why did you suddenly give birth prematurely!" an old man roared in a strong tone, and his loud voice could be heard throughout the corridor."I was fine when I came home to see me yesterday, but as soon as I got back I was going to give birth?! Tell me, what's going on?"

Shi Chengyin was startled by the roar, but immediately recognized the owner of the voice."Grandpa?"

She stood at the corner and saw her grandfather, who was recovering well from his illness, standing in front of the delivery room, scolding Wen Jingrui and Wen Xien who looked haggard.

It turns out that Wen Xilin was born prematurely... She really deserved it.she thought viciously.

The two culprits who caused Wen Xilin's premature birth looked at each other and lowered their heads with guilty conscience.

"Xian and I had a quarrel because of our differences in ideas, and Linlin tried to persuade her..." Wen Jingrui coughed, apologizing and blaming himself.

Wen Xilin's birth canal was not opened after she was sent to the hospital. The doctor said that if the condition of the birth canal did not improve, it was recommended to have a caesarean section, but she insisted on trying again because natural birth was better for the baby.Thinking that she had been in pain for more than ten hours, Wen Jingrui couldn't hide his anxiety and crawled through his messy hair.

Wen Xi'en was also frightened. Regardless of the fact that it was late at night and she had to go to class tomorrow morning, she followed her to the hospital. She stayed up all night and stood outside the delivery room listening to her sister's screams of pain. Her face turned pale and she regretted it endlessly."I won't dare anymore." Because she was worried about her sister's condition, she took leave and stayed in the hospital to wait for news.

"Is there something that makes Linlin want to break up the fight? Tell me clearly!"

While Wen Zuxiong was recuperating, Wen Xilin often came to visit, helping him peel fruits and cooking porridge for him. Although it was not delicious, she missed him in a house of women. He had three wives, seven daughters, and countless granddaughters, but she never ate the food cooked by them or the fruits they peeled. Instead, they all were raised by him.

So Wen Xilin's thoughtfulness made him soften. He asked her why she wanted to get close to him, an old man, and learned that he just saw her being bullied and saved her. She has been grateful and admired her since childhood, which made him deeply regret his wrong treatment of her and thought that he must love her well in the future.

Unexpectedly, it was the quarrel between these two ignorant guys this morning that caused her to give birth prematurely, and Wen Zuxiong became very angry.

But the culprits kept their mouths shut and refused to speak.

"Speak quickly!" The more Wen Zuxiong looked at him, the more he felt that there was something wrong with these two people and insisted that they speak.

At this time the doctor came out and brought good news.

"The mother's birth canal is fully opened and she is now ready to enter the delivery room. Mr. Wen, do you want to come in and accompany your wife?"

"I'm going." Wen Jingrui immediately stood up from the chair, not in the mood to say hello to Wen Zuxiong, and followed the doctor in with stiff limbs.He had already promised Wen Xilin that he would stay with her when she gave birth to her baby.

Seeing that his grandson-in-law was so nervous that he was walking with the same hands and feet, Wen Zuxiong couldn't help but feel funny and relieved.Fortunately, Shireen married a man who loved her.

"Xian, what are you and your brother-in-law arguing about? Is it ridiculous for a child to quarrel with an adult? You don't even listen to your sister's advice. What happened?" Wen Zuxiong turned around and asked Wen Xi'en.

Wen Xi'en's face was wrinkled, and she looked like she didn't want to say anything at first. Then she looked thoughtful, looked at Wen Zuxiong's serious face, and then spoke."Grandpa——"

With the sun shining brightly overhead, reporters who pretended to enter the hospital to borrow the bathroom secretly captured precious news footage. They immediately used the Internet to let the public see Wen Jingrui holding his newborn son in the ward with a nervous and frightened expression, as well as the affectionate scene of hand-feeding his wife after giving birth.

Wen Jingrui's right-hand man Fu Yu also came outside the hospital to distribute photos of the baby's feet that were developed as quickly as possible and brought further information to reporters."Dear senior reporters, our president has said that he wants his wife to take good care of herself and will definitely invite you all to dinner when she is one month old." The intention of chasing people away is obvious.

After the reporters got the pictures they wanted and were able to deliver the work, they stopped insisting on waiting where they were and packed up their things to leave the hospital.

Fu Yuze continued to distribute the photos to the media who had not received them. Suddenly a gust of wind blew and he lost his grip on any of them. Several photos fell out of his hand. He hurriedly bent down and picked up the photos everywhere.

At this time, a pair of dark red python pattern pointed-toe high heels stepped on one of the photos. The owner of the shoes slowly knelt down and picked up the photo. It was Shi Chengyin.

She stopped in front of an SNG car, staring at Wen Xilin's son's little feet with vicious eyes, and heard the news being broadcast in the SNG car in her ears——

"A piece of news for everyone. Wen Jingrui, the president of Poseidon Yacht Group, became a married man ten months ago and a father an hour ago. Now we are showing the exclusive footage of this station for the public. Judging from the photos, whether it is holding a child or feeding his wife, he can do it all with ease. The way he dotes on his wife and children can be said to be the best portrayal of a new good man..."

Shi Chengyin turned around slowly and saw several images inside the unlocked car door, all of which were blurry candid photos of Wen Xilin and Wen Jingrui.

"Haha...hahaha..." She laughed weirdly.Looking at those loving scenes and thinking about the message she just heard, she felt very funny.

"Let me tell you, how could Wen Xilin catch a big fish? Everything is fake, fake." Shi Chengyin thought, if all Taiwanese people knew that Wen Jingrui's mysterious wife was an illegitimate daughter with an unknown father, and those loving and sweet appearances were simply lies, what kind of expression would Wen Xilin have?

This woman ruined her life. From the moment she sent that wedding invitation, everything changed!If it weren't for her, her grandfather would still love her, her father would still be the general manager of Future Construction, and she would still be the Shi Chengyin whom everyone holds in the palm of their hands.

Wen Xilin, since you ruined me, I should reciprocate, right?

"Do you want an exclusive?" Shi Chengyin asked the reporters who had not yet left."Wen Jingrui has always been very protective of his wife. No one knows who she is or where she comes from, but I know her details."

"Really? Tell me, I hope you can provide evidence." The reporter raised his eyebrows, doubtfully picked up the recorder and started recording.

Picking up the last photo, Fu Yu raised his head and saw Shi Chengyin who was talking to the reporter. He also heard what she said. He raised his eyebrows slightly, and his gentle face couldn't help but show sympathy.

"This woman is really a hopeless fool. How come she still doesn't understand that messing with the wife means messing with the CEO?" Fu Yu shook his head and sighed, then turned back to the hospital and reported the matter to his boss.

A week later.

At four o'clock in the afternoon, in a noisy McDonald's, a group of female college students took their meals and sat down near the window, gossiping excitedly.

"Have you read the news? I originally didn't know what Prospect Construction, Wen's Financial Holdings, and Poseidon Yacht Group were. Thanks to the news during this period, I have figured out what these companies are doing. I know everything about stock prices and personnel. What's more, I even thought about the topic of my thesis, which is "Horiki of Poseidon Group"! Oh, yes, my dad also bought stocks in these three companies, which makes money."

One of the female college students said excitedly, but was immediately booed.

"Please, are you a woman? Can you please be romantic?" Another female college student with short hair rolled her eyes at Sister Tao, and then showed a dreamy look."Oh my God, I really want such a loving man. He will take care of me when I was a child, and he will never forget me when I grow up. After we reunite, we will get married in a flash and continue the deep friendship between our childhood sweethearts!"
